claim: Lieu de Mémoire au Chambon opens daily except Monday 10h-12h30 and 14h-18h from 2 May to 30 Sep; low-season Wed-Sat 14h-18h; full price €5 (€7 during temporary exhibitions), reduced €3.
quote: haute saison (2 mai - 30 septembre) : tous les jours, sauf le lundi : de 10h à 12h30 et de 14h à 18h ... Plein tarif : 5 € (7 € en période d'exposition temporaire) ... Tarif réduit : 3 € (5 € en période d'exposition)

claim: The Lieu de Mémoire reopened 4 March 2026 with a temporary exhibition on the end of the Shoah 1944-1948, running through 31 May 2026.
quote: Le Lieu de mémoire du Chambon-sur-Lignon rouvrira ses portes le 4 mars avec une expo sur la Shoah ... la fin de la Shoah de 1944 à 1948 ... jusqu'au 31 mai

claim: Le Chambon and surrounding Plateau Vivarais-Lignon villages (pop. ~24,000) sheltered about 3,000-3,500 Jews from 1940 to 1944, led by Pastor André Trocmé.
quote: the inhabitants of the French village of Le Chambon-sur-Lignon (population 5,000) and the villages on the surrounding plateau (population 24,000) provided refuge for an estimated 5,000 people, including about 3,000–3,500 Jews

claim: In 1990 Yad Vashem collectively honored Le Chambon-sur-Lignon and surrounding communes as Righteous Among the Nations — one of only two collective tributes ever awarded.
quote: the people of Le Chambon-sur-Lignon and the neighboring communes ... A plaque on the Yad Vashem grounds was unveiled in 1990 to commemorate

claim: Musée des Papeteries Canson & Montgolfier (700 rue de Vidalon, Davézieux near Annonay) opens Wed & Sun 14h30-18h year-round, daily 14h15-18h in July-Aug; adult €6.50, child 6-16 €5.
quote: Mercredi & Dimanche, 14h30-18h ... Du 1er juillet au 31 août : tous les jours, 14h15-18h ... Plein tarif : 6,50 € ... 6 à 16 ans : 5 €

claim: Musée Saint-Régis in Lalouvesc opens daily from 30 March to 9 November 2026 with free admission; the diorama in 19 painted scenes by Georges Serraz depicts the saint's life.
quote: From 30/03 to 09/11/2026 every day ... Free participation ... a diorama in 19 paintings by the artist Georges Serraz

claim: The Basilique Saint-Régis at Lalouvesc, built 1865-1877, houses the relics of Jesuit Jean-François Régis and (since 2018) of Sainte Thérèse Couderc.
quote: La basilique Saint-Régis de Lalouvesc est un édifice religieux catholique construit entre 1865 et 1877 ... abrite les reliques de saint Jean-François Régis, l'apôtre du Vivarais, mort à Lalouvesc

claim: The École Nationale Supérieure de la Pâtisserie (ENSP), founded 1984 by Yves Thuriès and Alain Ducasse, occupies the 19th-century Château de Montbarnier in Yssingeaux.
quote: L'ENSP est installée dans le château de Montbarnier ... créée en 1984 par Yves Thuriès et Alain Ducasse

claim: Yssingeaux's Hôtel de Ville is a 15th-century fortified former summer residence built by Jean de Bourbon, bishop of Le Puy, on Place du Général-de-Gaulle, open only by guided tour.
quote: Bishop Jean of Bourbon, bishop at Puy-en-Velay, built a summer residence for the prelates. It was built as a true fortress ... open only for guided tours

claim: Château d'Artias at Retournac, perched on a pyramidal rock, is a freely accessible medieval ruin with eco-museum, botanical garden and bailiff's house; allow ~1h30.
quote: Le château d'Artias ... accès libre ... maison d'accueil avec de nombreux objets médiévaux ... un jardin botanique ... Prévoir 1h30 pour la visite

claim: Tence offers a Pénitents Blancs chapel-museum (open July-Aug Wed-Sat, otherwise by reservation) and a small Museum of Pharmacy, set among four bell towers.
quote: the Pénitents Blancs chapel-museum ... open in July and August ... Museum of Pharmacy, open in July and August Thursdays

claim: Le Chambon-sur-Lignon lies 20.4 km / ~18 minutes by road from Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid; Annonay is ~28 km / ~29 minutes.
quote: Distance Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid Le Chambon-sur-Lignon : 20,4 km en voiture, 18 min
